files.prompt: Edit the supplied original aquarium theme image into ONE continuous wide panorama for three adjacent portrait mobile viewports (approximately 27:16 aspect ratio, landscape). Theme: 물속의 오로라. Preserve its recognizable identity, original color palette, materials, lighting, atmosphere, painterly illustration style and signature scenery. Recompose and extend the environment horizontally instead of stretching, mirroring or repeating the original. This is a scenic environment redesign, not merely an empty extension: distribute tasteful existing-theme scenery/props/vegetation/rocks/architecture naturally across LEFT, CENTER and RIGHT thirds, with an attractive focal accent in EACH third. Use varied heights and sizes, layered depth and connected floor/water planes; each viewport should feel intentionally composed while all three join seamlessly. The central third may contain tasteful decorations now, not an empty corridor. Keep broad clear swimming lanes and quiet negative space through the upper and mid water; do not clutter or block the whole view. Preserve any distinctive architectural or sculptural motifs already in the reference. No newly added live fish, animals or characters: actual aquarium inhabitants are rendered separately. No text, labels, signs with letters, UI, glass frame, borders, panels, dividers, triptych, collage, seams or watermarks. Single coherent landscape image, elegant and polished, same feeling as the original theme.
